name: bank_accounts
title: Bank Accounts
description: A real-world bank or card account whose statements this system imports, paired with the book-side cash account it reconciles against (fin_account_id). Small and hand-entered -- the statements are the volume. Reconciliation compares two independent truths: the bank's (bank_lines, imported evidence) and ours (fin_journals through fin_account_id). Keeping them as separate records is the whole point; never 'fix' a bank line to match the books.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.help: How you refer to it: 'Business Checking', 'Amex 1004'.

fields.name: last4
fields.label: Last 4
fields.help: Last four digits only -- never store a full account number.

fields.name: fin_account_id
fields.label: Book Account
fields.help: The cash/asset account in the chart of accounts this bank account's balance should agree with.

fields.name: entity_id
fields.label: Entity
fields.help: The set of books this account belongs to (65 multi-entity).
